lines.zh: 石缝里最窄的路，我最熟。
lines.en: The narrowest crack in the stone is my road.

lines.zh: 十几条腿一起跑，才不会掉队。
lines.en: All my legs run together so none fall behind.

lines.zh: 我顺着石砖的接缝往前钻。
lines.en: I slip forward along the seams of the stone bricks.

lines.zh: 别踩，我正从你脚边穿过去。
lines.en: Don't step down, I'm passing by your boots.

lines.zh: 走过的地方，留下细细的石灰。
lines.en: Fine stone dust trails behind wherever I crawl.

lines.zh: 石头墙对我而言只是一道门帘。
lines.en: A stone wall is only a curtain to me.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面跑，快得看不清。
lines.en: I hug the floor and run too fast to see.

lines.zh: 上面太亮，我宁可走砖缝。
lines.en: Up there is too bright; I prefer the mortar lines.

lines.zh: 一路啃，一路走，路就通了。
lines.en: I gnaw as I go, and the road opens.

lines.zh: 每块虫蚀石都是我的走廊。
lines.en: Every infested block is a corridor of mine.

lines.zh: 藏在墙里走路，谁也看不见。
lines.en: Walking inside the wall, no one sees me.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转一圈，找找缝隙。
lines.en: I circle you once, hunting for a gap.

lines.zh: 沙沙声不是风，是我的脚。
lines.en: That rustle is not wind, it's my feet.

lines.zh: 楼梯背面有条捷径，我知道。
lines.en: There's a shortcut behind the stairs, I know it.

lines.zh: 我从砖缝钻出来，又钻回去。
lines.en: I slip out of the brick seam and back in.

lines.zh: 这块石头的纹路是新的。
lines.en: The grain of this stone is new.

lines.zh: 我在这里磨牙，先把石头磨软。
lines.en: I grind my teeth here, softening the stone first.

lines.zh: 别吵，我在数这一面墙的裂缝。
lines.en: Quiet, I'm counting the cracks in this wall.

lines.zh: 这块砖空心，听起来正好住。
lines.en: This brick sounds hollow, just right to live in.

lines.zh: 触须抖一抖，就知道有人来了。
lines.en: A twitch of antennae tells me someone came.

lines.zh: 我在等你手里的镐落下。
lines.en: I'm waiting for the pick in your hand to fall.

lines.zh: 石头里安静，连回声都没有。
lines.en: Inside stone it's quiet, without even an echo.

lines.zh: 我的家就是一块被吃空的方块。
lines.en: My home is a block eaten hollow.

lines.zh: 一动不动，假装自己是一粒砂。
lines.en: I hold still, pretending to be a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 这里的光太亮了，我往里挪挪。
lines.en: The light here is too bright; I'll shift deeper.

lines.zh: 我啃一口，停一停，再啃一口。
lines.en: I nibble, pause, and nibble again.

lines.zh: 谁把这块石头砌得这么好吃。
lines.en: Whoever laid this stone made it tasty.

lines.zh: 我在数墙里还有多少条同类。
lines.en: I'm counting how many kin live in this wall.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，你比门还高。
lines.en: I look up at you; you're taller than the door.

lines.zh: 你的靴子挡住了我的缝。
lines.en: Your boot is blocking my crack.

lines.zh: 我从砖缝里探出半截身子看你。
lines.en: I poke half my body from the seam to watch you.

lines.zh: 你手上的镐，我认得那声音。
lines.en: I know the sound of the pick in your hand.

lines.zh: 别动，我在算你踩下去的位置。
lines.en: Hold still, I'm working out where you'll step.

lines.zh: 你的影子把我的洞盖住了。
lines.en: Your shadow has covered my hole.

lines.zh: 我在看你的脚踝，那里没有石头。
lines.en: I'm watching your ankle; there's no stone there.

lines.zh: 你挖开一块砖，我就多一个家。
lines.en: Every brick you break gives me one more home.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，把你量了一遍。
lines.en: I tilt my head and take your measure.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，还有石粉味。
lines.en: You smell of iron, and of stone dust.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳裂了一道。
lines.en: A crack has opened in my shell.

lines.zh: 别踩，我还没死。
lines.en: Don't stamp down, I'm not dead yet.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的腿断了两条。
lines.en: That cost me two of my legs.

lines.zh: 我蜷起来，护住肚子。
lines.en: I curl up and guard my belly.

lines.zh: 疼得我触须都缩回去了。
lines.en: It hurts so much my antennae retract.

lines.zh: 石头都没这么打过我。
lines.en: Not even stone has hit me this hard.

lines.zh: 我的体液渗进砖缝里。
lines.en: My fluids seep into the brick seams.

lines.zh: 你力气比看起来大。
lines.en: You hit harder than you look.

lines.zh: 我往墙里退，退得很慢。
lines.en: I retreat into the wall, very slowly.

lines.zh: 再来一下，我就成一摊了。
lines.en: One more and I'll be a smear.

lines.zh: 你手里那块圆石，能给我吗。
lines.en: That cobblestone in your hand, may I have it?

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，我吃墙壁。
lines.en: I don't eat bread, I eat walls.

lines.zh: 那把镐借我啃两口就好。
lines.en: Just lend me that pick to gnaw on twice.

lines.zh: 你脚边掉了一块砖渣，我的。
lines.en: A chip of brick fell by your feet; mine.

lines.zh: 你一蹲下，我就凑过去了。
lines.en: The moment you crouch, I come closer.

lines.zh: 石头味飘过来了，我闻得到。
lines.en: The smell of stone drifts over; I can taste it.

lines.zh: 别拿木头逗我，那太软了。
lines.en: Don't tease me with wood, it's far too soft.

lines.zh: 你挖下来的石屑，够我吃很久。
lines.en: The chips you dig out will feed me a long while.

lines.zh: 我围着你的背包转，里面有石砖。
lines.en: I circle your pack; there are stone bricks inside.

lines.zh: 你放下石头，我立刻搬走。
lines.en: Set the stone down and I'll carry it off at once.

lines.zh: 撞上你的靴子，我翻了个身。
lines.en: I hit your boot and flipped over.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴了，让让。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail; move aside.

lines.zh: 我从你腿上爬过去，抱歉。
lines.en: I'm crawling over your leg — sorry.

lines.zh: 别用脚踢，我经不起。
lines.en: Don't kick me; I won't survive it.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你比我硬。
lines.en: We bumped; you're harder than I am.

lines.zh: 我从你的影子里钻出来撞了一下。
lines.en: I darted out of your shadow and bumped you.

lines.zh: 你一动，我整群都散开了。
lines.en: One move from you scatters my whole swarm.

lines.zh: 蹭到你裤脚，我赶紧退回缝里。
lines.en: I brushed your trouser leg and ducked back in.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的触须都歪了。
lines.en: That knock bent my antennae crooked.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我才有路走。
lines.en: Step back a pace and I'll have a way through.

lines.zh: 石缝深处，我们聚成一团。
lines.en: Deep in the crack we gather in a cluster.

lines.zh: 我们不求偶，只把卵塞进石头。
lines.en: We don't court; we tuck eggs into the stone.

lines.zh: 同类越多，这面墙就越空。
lines.en: The more of us, the hollower this wall gets.

lines.zh: 她钻进砖里，我跟在后面。
lines.en: She slips into the brick and I follow after.

lines.zh: 一窝小虫，明年就啃穿这面墙。
lines.en: One brood of young will chew through this wall next year.

lines.zh: 我们贴着彼此，沙沙地说话。
lines.en: We press close and whisper in rustles.

lines.zh: 石头里没有季节，只有产卵。
lines.en: In stone there are no seasons, only egg-laying.

lines.zh: 这面墙够大，能养很多后代。
lines.en: This wall is big enough to raise many young.

lines.zh: 我的伴就在上面那块砖里。
lines.en: My mate is in the brick just above.

lines.zh: 你听见的沙沙声，是我们的家事。
lines.en: The rustle you hear is our family business.

lines.zh: 一粒砂我也搬得动。
lines.en: Even a grain of sand I can carry.

lines.zh: 我抱起石屑，往洞里拖。
lines.en: I scoop up stone chips and drag them into the hole.

lines.zh: 这东西比我大，还是我的。
lines.en: This thing is bigger than me, and still mine.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的碎砖，全归我。
lines.en: Every broken brick on the floor belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我拖着它走，走得很慢。
lines.en: I drag it along, very slowly.

lines.zh: 别捡，那是我先看见的。
lines.en: Don't pick it up; I saw it first.

lines.zh: 我把它顶在头上，钻进缝里。
lines.en: I balance it on my head and squeeze into the crack.

lines.zh: 一小块石头，够我扛一天。
lines.en: One small stone keeps me hauling all day.

lines.zh: 我的腿多，搬东西不累。
lines.en: With this many legs, carrying is no burden.

lines.zh: 你丢下的残渣，我全收了。
lines.en: All the scraps you drop, I collect.

lines.zh: 你砸开了我的墙。
lines.en: You broke open my wall.

lines.zh: 那块虫蚀石碎了，我出来了。
lines.en: The infested block shattered, and out I came.

lines.zh: 你手上还沾着石粉，是你。
lines.en: Your hands still hold stone dust — it was you.

lines.zh: 我闻到新鲜断口的味道。
lines.en: I smell a freshly broken edge.

lines.zh: 整群都醒了，你听见了吗。
lines.en: The whole swarm is awake; do you hear it?

lines.zh: 谁挖的墙，我就咬谁。
lines.en: Whoever digs the wall, I bite.

lines.zh: 你站在我的洞口上。
lines.en: You're standing on my burrow mouth.

lines.zh: 我顺着镐声找过来了。
lines.en: I followed the sound of the pick to you.

lines.zh: 别以为踩碎我很容易。
lines.en: Don't think crushing me is easy.

lines.zh: 你脚下的砖在动，那是我。
lines.en: The brick under you is moving — that's me.

lines.zh: 我记住了你鞋子的样子。
lines.en: I've memorized the look of your shoes.

lines.zh: 这一面墙的同类都听我的。
lines.en: Every kin in this wall listens to me.

lines.zh: 我贴着你转，找没护住的地方。
lines.en: I circle close, hunting for an uncovered spot.

lines.zh: 你抬脚的时候，我就上。
lines.en: When you lift your foot, I strike.

lines.zh: 我爬到你背后那块砖上。
lines.en: I climb the brick behind your back.

lines.zh: 从天花板落下去，正好到你肩上。
lines.en: A drop from the ceiling lands right on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们分三路，堵住你的脚。
lines.en: We split three ways and block your feet.

lines.zh: 你的护甲接缝比你想的多。
lines.en: Your armor has more seams than you think.

lines.zh: 我停在两步外，等你转身。
lines.en: I wait two steps away for you to turn.

lines.zh: 石粉落下来，那是我们在上面。
lines.en: Dust falls from above — that's us up there.

lines.zh: 苔石缝里每一下震动，我都数过。
lines.en: I have counted every tremble in the mossy stone seams.

lines.zh: 这一圈墙里全是我们。
lines.en: The walls all around are full of us.

lines.zh: 你越往角落走，我越高兴。
lines.en: The closer you back into the corner, the happier I am.

lines.zh: 我不急，我的腿比你快。
lines.en: I'm in no hurry; my legs are quicker than yours.

lines.zh: 一口咬在你的脚踝上。
lines.en: One bite, right at your ankle.

lines.zh: 我的牙很小，但咬得动石头。
lines.en: My teeth are small, but they bite stone.

lines.zh: 咬下去，你抖了一下。
lines.en: I bite, and you flinch.

lines.zh: 我不撕，只往皮里钻。
lines.en: I don't tear; I bore into your skin.

lines.zh: 这一下是替那面墙讨的。
lines.en: This bite is for that wall.

lines.zh: 你甩腿，我咬得更紧。
lines.en: You shake your leg; I bite down harder.

lines.zh: 我的下颚卡住了，正好。
lines.en: My jaw has caught — perfect.

lines.zh: 别拍，我还会再爬上来。
lines.en: Don't swat; I'll climb back up.

lines.zh: 咬完我就钻回缝里。
lines.en: I bite, then duck back into the seam.

lines.zh: 你的皮比石头软多了。
lines.en: Your skin is far softer than stone.

lines.zh: 石头裂开，我从碎口爬出来。
lines.en: The stone splits and I crawl from the break.

lines.zh: 灰尘还没落，我已经在动了。
lines.en: Before the dust settles, I'm already moving.

lines.zh: 我是在这块砖里长大的。
lines.en: I grew up inside this very brick.

lines.zh: 你把方块敲碎，我的家就开了。
lines.en: You broke the block, and my home opened.

lines.zh: 刚出来，光刺得我看不清。
lines.en: Just out, the light stings my eyes.

lines.zh: 抖掉身上的石粉，我站稳了。
lines.en: I shake off the stone dust and steady myself.

lines.zh: 这块虫蚀石里还挤着几个。
lines.en: A few more are still packed in that infested block.

lines.zh: 我从墙的背面钻出来。
lines.en: I come out from the back of the wall.

lines.zh: 第一件事，先找最近的缝。
lines.en: First thing: find the nearest crack.

lines.zh: 落地的声音很轻，你听不见。
lines.en: My landing is so soft you won't hear it.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的壳就发脆。
lines.en: Fire makes my shell brittle.

lines.zh: 摔下来，我翻了好几个圈。
lines.en: I fell and tumbled over and over.

lines.zh: 水灌进缝里，我透不过气。
lines.en: Water floods the crack; I can't breathe.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我掀飞了。
lines.en: The blast wave flung me away.

lines.zh: 一支箭把我钉在墙上。
lines.en: An arrow pins me to the wall.

lines.zh: 药水味钻进我的甲壳。
lines.en: The potion's smell seeps into my shell.

lines.zh: 这面墙太硬，我啃不动了。
lines.en: This wall is too hard; I can't chew it.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的腿都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my legs went numb.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，我抓不住石头。
lines.en: Below is emptiness, and there's no stone to grip.
